source_text.body:
Build and launch a market research SaaS with Replit
The poster used Replit's agent to help build a market research SaaS and made a first sale after months of weekend work.
·
May 28, 2026
Done with
RA
Replit Agent
What they did
The poster says they were a non-developer and used Replit to build a market research SaaS over 8–9 months, mostly on weekends. They say the first version took 2–3 months, then they spent another 5–6 months using Reddit feedback to make it genuinely useful; they also launched on Product Hunt, watched Replit pricing, and later moved hosting to Render with the database on Supabase while still using the agent.
How it went
They say they got their first sale the month before posting after launching without a network and doing no paid marketing, with traffic and feedback coming organically from Reddit. The main limitation they mention is time: progress was slow because they only worked on weekends.
Worth knowing
Most of the build stretched to 8–9 months because it was weekend-only work, even though the initial version took 2–3 months.
Try it yourself
with
Replit Agent
Copy prompt
Help me build a [type of product, e.g. market research tool] web app for [target customer]. Start by proposing the core features and a simple first version I can show people, then build it step by step with sign-up, [key feature] and a way to take payment. Pause and ask me before you connect any payment account or publish it live.
Original source: https://www.reddit.com/r/replit/comments/1tq6rwo/made_my_first_dollar_on_internet_using_replit
